[SWS_SM_00687] ErrorCode for failed LeaveSuspendToRam
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005, RS_SM_00402
⌈
If the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
detects an error when processing the
LeaveSuspendToRam
ActionListItem
, the configured
leaveSuspendToRamEr-
ror
shall be used as ErrorCode in the
Controller
’s
ErrorRecoveryTable
.
